topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Rain's been hammering the city, turning the streets into rivers. Got a call from these two, siblings, stepping into their grandmother's shoes, or so they say. House on the corner of Elm and Oak—standing there like a ghost of the past. They reckon there's more to the will than just the house. Whispers about hidden stashes, maybe even a trunk full of secrets. Now, they're poking around, looking for answers, but what they might find could change things. They're sitting in my office, two cups of stale coffee on the desk. They talk about family bonds, but you can see the tension, the weight of the past. I tell 'em I'll look into it, that maybe there's more to the story than just the walls and the memories.
